name: Our Ogre Friend
summary: A goblin asks you to find Gobam in Bolder'ok and bring food for Snufflesnout, Chub'chob's pet boar. Gobam is willing to help because Chub'chob is his friend.

sections.title: A Friend’s Request
sections.body: After you win a few battles, the goblin asks you to find Gobam in Bolder'ok. He needs food for Snufflesnout, Chub'chob's pet boar, but says his work keeps him busy. Gobam is east of Clugfist's clubhouse, and the goblin hopes you can find him.

faq.answer: Gobam is the shy fellow the goblin sends you to find in Bolder'ok.
Gobam is east of Clugfist's clubhouse in Bolder'ok.
Snufflesnout is Chub'chob's pet boar, and the goblin asks you to bring food for it.

faq.q: Why does the goblin need help?
faq.answer: The goblin says his work keeps him busy, so he asks you to find food for Snufflesnout.
Gobam says he dislikes the goblin, but he will help Chub'chob because they are good friends.

attribution: In-game quest text: Our Ogre Friend
